[5] (ran4_cr_chunks 38.133, sim=0.6853)
[CR CR1387 for 38.133] Reason for change: The clause numbering for two new NR-U clauses is according to the earlier agreed specification structure in R4-1914628, but is currently missing the corresonding necessary top-level and preceding clauses in TS 38.133. Namely: we have 9.1A.3.2 and 9.1A.3.2a but there are no top-level clauses for them, e.g., 9.1A.3 or even 9.1A and we have no 9.1A.3.1 either. Introducing these missing top-level sections (approach 1) is not optimal and will result in a lot of redundancy, therefore we propose (approach 2) to just change to 9.1.3A.1 and 9.1.3A.1A and introduce 9.1.3A. Summary of change: Clause numbering is corrected Consequences if not approved: Incorrect clause numbering, incomplete clauses structure

[6] (ran4_cr_chunks 38.133, sim=0.6839)
[CR CR1011r1 for 38.133] Reason for change: CR 0718, which introduced clause 6.1A, was implemented between clauses within clause 6.1. The current place is wrong, changes the scope of clauses 6.1.2, 6.1.3 and 6.1.4 and causes confusion in the specification. Summary of change: This CR changes introduces clause 6.1B in TS 38.133, and deletes the content of clause 6.1A and its subclauses. Additionally, this CR changes occurences of LBT in the text to CCA, so that the terms are consistent throughout the text. Consequences if not approved: The specification is wrong.

[10] (ran4_tdoc_chunks R4-2000040, sim=0.6348)
In RAN4 92b, companies agreed to split the specifications from the second level and create new sub-clauses for NR-U and to use the color coding proposed in [4]. (In this paper the same color coding is used) For example, to reflect the impact of LBT to NR intra-frequency measurements, a new clause 9.2A NR intra-frequency measurements when CCA is used is created corresponding to 9.2 NR intra-frequency measurements where CCA is excluded by default. All the sub-sections in 9.2 will be duplicated in 9.2A, adding or modifying some content to address the changes due to LBT. As an instance, for intra-frequency SFTD measurements, the clauses in 9.2 is listed below: 9.2.5.4 SFTD Measurements between PCell and PSCell 9.2.5.4.1 Introduction 9.2.5.4.2 SFTD Measurement delay 9.2.5.4.3 SFTD Measurement R
